marrow is **alpha**. Both Apache Arrow and Mojo are moving targets, and this
page is the honest inventory — kept next to the machine-checked sources it is
derived from, so it can be re-verified rather than believed.

## How correctness is measured

Two independent checks, neither of which grades marrow against itself:

- **The golden corpus** — `golden/`, **278 query cases**. Each records a SQL
  query, the answer **generated from DuckDB**, and the marrow spelling. The
  expectations are *never* regenerated from marrow. The corpus currently
  carries **zero `xfail`s**: every case that compiles, passes.
- **Arrow archery integration** — the official cross-implementation suite, run
  against the **C++, Rust and Go** implementations in both directions
  (`pixi run -e integration integration`).

## Known-wrong answers

::: {.callout-warning}
## Float division by zero answers the dividend

`DivKernel` substitutes a `1` divisor so the SIMD lane cannot trap, so
`10.0 / 0.0` is `10.0` where IEEE 754 and DuckDB both say `inf`; `-10.0 / 0.0`
is `-10.0`, and `0.0 / 0.0` is `0.0`.

**No golden case pins it**, which is how it survived — so it is the one
known-wrong answer the corpus does not currently catch. Integer `//` and `%` by
zero are unaffected and answer NULL, as SQL does.
:::

One latent trap is worth knowing too: `count(*)` desugars to `count(lit(1))`,
whose referenced-column set is empty, so anything that prunes by "what does
this read" would prune every column. Column pruning handles it by never
narrowing a source to zero columns.

## What the corpus measures as missing

63 of the 278 cases carry `-- skip mojo`: marrow has no API for them, so the
SQL and the DuckDB answer are recorded and the marrow body is a *proposal*
rather than a verified spelling.

| cases | area |
|---:|---|
| 13 | aggregates — median, quantile, first/last, arg_min/arg_max, string_agg, corr/covar, mode, skewness, `bool_and`/`bool_or` |
| 10 | temporal — date_diff, age, strftime/strptime, make_date, iso_week |
| 8 | nested — struct field, map lookup, list element/slice, unnest |
| 7 | math — atan2 and the rest of the trigonometric family |
| 5 | string — regexp, concat_ws |
| 4 | set operations — UNION / EXCEPT / INTERSECT |
| 4 | joins — cross, non-equi, asof |
| 3 | GROUPING SETS / ROLLUP / CUBE |
| 3 | filters — SQL `NOT IN` null semantics, `.is_in` as a method |
| 3 | decimals in expressions |
| 2 | subqueries |
| 1 | `DISTINCT ON` |

`golden/COVERAGE.md` is the authoritative, machine-checked version of this
table.

## Capability by layer

| | Status |
|---|---|
| **Layouts** | bool, numeric, string/large_string, binary/large_binary, fixed_size_binary, list/large_list/fixed_size_list, struct, map, dictionary, decimal (32/64/128/256), temporal — **implemented**. Union, run-end-encoded and view layouts — **not** |
| **Sources** | Parquet and Arrow IPC only. **No CSV, no JSON.** `scan`/`read_parquet` takes **one file** — no globs, directories, hive partitions or object storage |
| **Parquet** | native reader and writer, snappy/zstd/lz4, data page v1 & v2, statistics, page index. Bloom filters are implemented but **off by default** and unreachable from Python. No modular encryption |
| **Optimizer** | 15 rules plus column pruning. **No cost model**, so no join reordering and no build-side selection |
| **Execution** | in-memory only — **no spilling anywhere**, so every aggregate and join is bounded by RAM |
| **Joins** | equijoins only: inner, left, right, full, semi, anti. No nested-loop, range or asof joins |
| **GPU** | element-wise kernels only (arithmetic, comparison, boolean, cast, hashing), and **off unless built with `-D MARROW_GPU=true`** |
| **UDFs** | none |

## Python-specific limits

The Python bindings are narrower than the Mojo core, and some of the gaps are
CPython-binding limits rather than missing features:

- **Aggregates are not on the eager surface.** `marrow.compute` has no `sum` /
  `min` / `max` / `mean`; reductions live in the query layer.
- **String and temporal verbs are unbound.** All 17 (`substr`, `lpad`,
  `replace`, `split_part`, `position`, `epoch`, `last_day`, `week`, …) exist and
  evaluate in **both** Mojo lanes; none is reachable from Python.
- **No window functions from Python.** They exist in the Mojo lane only.
- **Statistics pruning is unreachable from Python** — a `PythonObject` has
  already erased the type the pruning overload needs, so a filtered scan reads
  every row group.
- **`==` on a dtype or an array is identity comparison.** `tp_richcompare` is
  not reachable through the binding API, so `ma.int32() == ma.int32()` is
  `False`. Compare `str()` instead.
- **Methods where PyArrow has properties** — `Array.type()`,
  `RecordBatch.num_rows()`. The `tp_getset` slot is unexposed.

## Errors

There are 300+ `raise Error` sites and **zero typed exceptions**, so failures
cannot yet be caught by kind.
